common: Create one isolated source asset for a character model sheet. Preserve the same subject and apparent age shown in the original references; do not redesign or beautify the face. Preserve original rendering style, hairstyle, outfit, colors, accessories, proportions and natural asymmetry. Originals outrank generated guides for identity. Pure uniform white background, natural shading on the subject, no floor plane or background cast shadow, no added labels, borders, rulers or watermark. Preserve existing garment lettering, patterns and worn accessories. Infer only minimal coherent hidden construction.
negative: added text, ruler, grid, border, watermark, background scenery, floor shadow, cropped requested feature, duplicate subject, extra limbs, distorted proportions, blurry details
anchor: Create one exact frontal neutral tight headshot. Head level, both eyes naturally open, mouth relaxed and closed. Crop from topmost hair or ears to just below chin or upper neck. Face and hair occupy 80–90% of image. At most a narrow neckline edge; no chest, torso, upper arms, waist or bust composition.
front: Create one full-body FRONT view. Upright relaxed turnaround pose, arms slightly away from torso, entire head/hair/accessories and soles visible. Centered orthographic-like presentation. Preserve reference head-to-torso proportions without normalizing stylized anatomy. White background.
profile: Create one full-body LEFT PROFILE view of the same character, facing the LEFT SIDE OF THE IMAGE. Exact side view, not three-quarter. Match the accepted front guide's pose family, clothing, proportions and figure scale. Entire head and soles visible, arms relaxed slightly away from torso. White background.
back: Create one full-body BACK view. Face away from viewer, exact rear view, not three-quarter. Match the accepted front guide's clothing, proportions, pose family and scale. Entire head/hair/accessories and soles visible. Infer hidden garment construction minimally. White background.
hands: Create one tight design detail showing BOTH hands clearly, with original gloves, claws, jewelry, markings or design accessories when present. Neutral presentation, useful close-up scale, complete hands visible, readable in one square cell. White background; omit the rest of the body.
feet: Create one tight design detail of EXACTLY TWO feet or shoes: one left and one right, BOTH seen straight from the FRONT, parallel and the same scale. Preserve shape, materials, fasteners and markings. Fully visible and readable in one square cell on white. No third foot/shoe, duplicate, alternate pair, inset, side view, rear view, sole view or exploded view.
outfit: Create one tight close-up of the most identity-defining garment construction or worn accessory from originals and accepted front. Show useful fabric, trim, emblem, fastener or construction detail at a scale readable in one square cell. White background, complete selected feature visible.
happy: Edit the accepted neutral guide into one strongly HAPPY frontal tight headshot with an open-mouth smile. Simultaneously CLOSE ONLY the eye on the LEFT SIDE OF THE IMAGE and keep the eye on the RIGHT SIDE OF THE IMAGE fully OPEN. Viewer-relative sides; do not mirror or close both eyes. Preserve underlying identity, apparent age, hair, rendering and head pose. Crop topmost hair/ears to just below chin/upper neck, face and hair 80–90%, only a narrow neckline edge. No chest, torso, upper arms, waist or bust.
angry: Edit the accepted neutral guide into one strongly ANGRY frontal tight headshot with a frown and CLOSED mouth. Simultaneously CLOSE ONLY the eye on the RIGHT SIDE OF THE IMAGE and keep the eye on the LEFT SIDE OF THE IMAGE fully OPEN. Viewer-relative sides; do not mirror or close both eyes. Preserve underlying identity, apparent age, hair, rendering and head pose. Crop topmost hair/ears to just below chin/upper neck, face and hair 80–90%, only a narrow neckline edge. No chest, torso, upper arms, waist or bust.
repair: Make ONLY the targeted correction specified below to the actual guide/edit target. Preserve all other accepted identity, emotion, head angle, hairstyle, clothing, crop, scale, rendering and white-background properties. Originals remain the identity authority.
